entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The room was light and homely.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The large, rectangular kitchen had wooden beams and a stone floor.
entries.zh: 大型长方形厨房有木梁和石地板.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: It was a small, cosy lounge with a low, sloping ceiling.
entries.zh: 是一个小的舒适的休息室 一个低矮的天花板

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The study had a wooden floor and was painted cream.
entries.zh: 研究室有一个木地板,被涂上奶油.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The high-ceilinged dining room was furnished with a huge oak table and sideboard.
entries.zh: 高天楼的餐厅配备了巨大的橡木桌和侧板.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The room was a relaxing haven, furnished with comfy, deep leather couches and large floor cushions.
entries.zh: 房间是一个放松的避难所,布置有舒适的,深皮沙发和大地板的衬垫.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: A fire crackled in the open fireplace, making the living room a snug retreat from the grey, hissing veil of rain outside.
entries.zh: 在露天的壁炉中发生火灾,使客厅从外面的灰色的湿湿的雨纱上退缩.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The kitchen was a warm, welcoming room of gleaming, scrubbed and polished wood.
entries.zh: 厨房是一个温暖的欢迎室 闪光,洗涤和磨光的木头。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The furniture was old and battered and the carpet dirty and torn.
entries.zh: 家具老旧不堪,地毯又脏又撕。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The light flickered as if the bulbs were coming to the end of their days.
entries.zh: 灯光闪烁,仿佛灯泡即将到来

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The old house was dark and forbidding. The only sign of life was a torn curtain hanging across one of the upstairs windows.
entries.zh: 旧房子是黑暗和禁止的,唯一的生命迹象是悬在楼上一个窗户上的撕裂的窗帘.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The ground was so thick with rats that it seemed to be covered in a carpet of writhing hair.
entries.zh: 地面上有老鼠,似乎被毛毯覆盖

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: A buzzing strip light hung from the ceiling. Its casing was peppered with the bodies of dead flies.
entries.zh: 天花板上挂着一条响亮的条纹灯,它的外壳被死苍蝇的尸体胡椒涂上。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The big house was dusty and bare. All the stairs and corners were secretive places, covered in cobwebs. A place of shadows and whispers.
entries.zh: 大屋灰尘赤裸,所有楼梯和拐角都是隐秘的地方,被蜘蛛网覆盖,是阴暗和低语的地方.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: It may have once been a pleasant, comfortable room, but damp, dirt, disuse, mice and spiders had made it their home.
entries.zh: 它可能曾经是一个舒适舒适的房间,但潮湿,泥土,不使用,小鼠和蜘蛛使之成为了他们的家.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The windows were dirty and smeared with a layer of crawling damp and mould, and only a gloomy light could filter into the room.
entries.zh: 窗户是脏的,上面涂了一层爬行的潮湿和模具,只有阴暗的光能过滤进入房间.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: There was a wild, overgrown feel to the place, which made it easy to imagine the spirits of the dead haunting it. He imagined eyes watching him, ears listening.
entries.zh: 这个地方有一种野生的,过度生长的感受,这使得人们很容易想象死去的鬼魂纠缠着它,他想象着眼睛看着他,耳朵听.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: It appeared that no-one had lived in the house for some time. The wallpaper was torn and peeling, the carpet threadbare, the lights shimmering with cobwebs, and a cloud of dust hung over everything.
entries.zh: 似乎没有人在房子里住过一段时间,墙纸被撕裂剥落,地毯线盆,灯光闪烁着蜘蛛网,灰尘笼罩着一切。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The place was in chaos – curtains closed; dirty dishes piled high in the sink; rubbish spilling out of the bin; books, papers and clothes scattered and crumpled.
entries.zh: 当地一片混乱 — — 窗帘被关闭;水槽中堆积着高高的脏盘子;垃圾从垃圾桶里溢出;书籍,纸张和衣服散落和挤压.
